notes.text: Section, acts Apr. 5, 1906, ch. 1366, § 10, 34 Stat. 102; May 24, 1924, ch. 182, § 11, 43 Stat. 142, required consular officers to affix official fee stamps to documents in the performance of any consular or notarial act.
